meaning: seeming, seeming but not necessarily real

english.meaning: seeming, seeming but not necessarily real
english.note: Use this for something that seems to have a quality or identity without asserting that it really does.

exampleSentences.english: This person has an apparent air of professionalism, but actually knows nothing.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢個人貌似好專業，但其實乜都唔識。
